mission_09: Use screen.getByText(), screen.getByRole(), or screen.getByLabelText() to find elements. Use fireEvent.click() to simulate clicks.
For async tests, wrap assertions in await waitFor(() => { expect(...).toBeInTheDocument(); }).
Mock fetch with jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ json: () => Promise.resolve(data), ok: true })). Use act() for state updates.
